verdict.rationale: Ironclad's no-code contract builder, workflow designer, and templated workflows (ironclad-docs-9, ironclad-docs-16, ironclad-docs-38) show it can generate and route any type of contract, which could technically include offer letters, IP agreements, or option grants, and community evidence confirms it is used for contractor/employee paperwork (ironclad-comm-6). However, no evidence specifically names offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, or equity/option grant templates as supported document types. missing for 10: explicit templates or docs for offer letters, IP/confidentiality agreements, and option grant paperwork; case studies showing legal-ops teams running equity/hiring paperwork through Ironclad.
